name: session-search
description: Lexical search over local AI coding-agent session history (OpenCode and Pi).
author: faetschi-bot

scripts.check: node --check bin/session-search.mjs && for f in lib/*.mjs lib/core/*.mjs lib/sources/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.prepack: npm run check && node bin/session-search.mjs doctor
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run check && node bin/session-search.mjs doctor
